subject: gk
question: How many stages of Paleolithic Age are there in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Three**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Paleolithic Age** in India is divided into three stages: **Lower Paleolithic**, **Middle Paleolithic**, and **Upper Paleolithic**.
 
• The **Lower Paleolithic** stage is characterized by the use of **hand axes** and **cleavers** and dates back to approximately **2.5 million years ago** to **300,000 years ago**.
 
• The **Middle Paleolithic** stage saw the development of **flake tools** and is dated from around **300,000 years ago** to **30,000 years ago**.
 
• The **Upper Paleolithic** stage is marked by the emergence of **blade tools** and dates from around **30,000 years ago** to **10,000 years ago**.
 
• The **Paleolithic Age** represents the longest phase of human history and is significant for the development of early human technology and culture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lower Paleolithic**

 
 
• It is the earliest subdivision of the Paleolithic or Old Stone Age.
 
• Key sites: **Sohan Valley** and **Attirampakkam**.
 
 
 
• **Middle Paleolithic**
 
 
• Known for the development of **Levallois technique** for making tools.
 
• Key sites: **Bhimbetka** and **Didwana**.
 
 
 
• **Upper Paleolithic**
 
 
• Characterized by a diversity of stone tools.
 
• Key sites: **Belan Valley** and **Bagor**.
